fields.name: Classic Massage
fields.description: A classic massage designed to release muscular tension and encourage deep relaxation. The pressure and techniques are tailored to your needs, whether you prefer a firmer, more focused massage or a gentler treatment to help you slow down and unwind.

fields.name: Deep Tissue Massage
fields.description: A full-body restorative massage created to ease tired, tense and overworked muscles. Using firm pressure and targeted massage techniques, the treatment focuses on areas where tension tends to build up, making it ideal after physical activity or long hours spent sitting at a desk.

fields.name: Body Scrub
fields.description: A full-body invigorating salt scrub designed to refresh the skin and stimulate circulation. The treatment gently removes dull surface cells, leaving your skin feeling incredibly soft, smooth and radiant.

fields.name: Mineral Body Wrap
fields.description: A warming full-body wrap designed to soothe tired, stiff muscles and support recovery after physical activity. While the wrap takes effect, enjoy a relaxing face and scalp massage. The treatment is completed with a mineral-rich body cream blended with aromatic oils, leaving your skin soft and your body feeling restored.

fields.name: Repose Signature Facial
fields.description: A personalised facial experience beginning with a professional skin analysis, followed by gentle exfoliation, deep cleansing and a circulation-boosting facial massage. A nourishing mask is then applied to replenish and care for the skin. The experience is completed with a relaxing arm and hand massage. Suitable for all skin types.

fields.name: Glow Facial
fields.description: A deeply hydrating facial designed to restore moisture and natural radiance. Ideal for dull, tired or dehydrated skin, this treatment helps revive the complexion and enhance its natural glow. The treatment is tailored to your individual skin needs and combines gentle exfoliation, replenishing products and targeted care to leave the complexion feeling soft, smooth and refreshed.

fields.name: Repose Luxe
fields.description: Combine spa access with a treatment of your choice for a complete wellness experience. Enjoy time in our spa and fitness facilities before or after a 50- or 60-minute treatment.
fields.included:
Access to spa and fitness facilities
One treatment of your choice
Bathrobe, towels and slippers
Water, tea and fruit buffet

fields.name: Repose for Two
fields.description: A spa experience designed for two. The package includes spa access for two guests followed by a relaxing duo massage in the same treatment room.
fields.included:
Access to spa and fitness facilities for two guests
Duo massage in the same treatment room
Bathrobes, towels and slippers
Water, tea and fruit buffet

fields.name: After Work Spa
fields.description: Unwind after the day with evening spa access and a glass of prosecco or a non-alcoholic sparkling alternative. A perfect way to spend the evening with friends or colleagues.
fields.included:
Evening spa access
Access to spa and fitness facilities
One glass of prosecco or non-alcoholic sparkling alternative
Bathrobes, towels and slippers
Water, tea and fruit buffet

fields.name: Breakfast Spa
fields.description: Start your day with a fresh breakfast followed by access to our spa, wellness and fitness facilities. A calm and refreshing way to begin the morning.
fields.included:
Breakfast
Morning spa access
Access to spa and fitness facilities
Bathrobes, towels and slippers
Water, tea and fruit buffet

fields.name: Spa & Dine
fields.description: Combine your spa visit with a dining experience at Repose. Choose between morning spa followed by lunch, or afternoon spa followed by dinner.
fields.included:
Morning or afternoon spa access
Lunch or dinner in our dining area, depending on selected package
Access to spa and fitness facilities
Bathrobes, towels and slippers
Water, tea and fruit buffet
